# REST API reference

All endpoints take `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (a tenant API key, an OIDC token, or the bootstrap admin key plus `X-Tenant-Id`). The **scope** column is the permission the token needs; see [Security](../operations/security.md). Interactive docs are served at `/docs` and the machine-readable spec at `/openapi.json` ([download](openapi.json)).

Operational endpoints without auth: `GET /healthz`, `GET /readyz`, `GET /metrics`. The MCP endpoint is `/mcp` (see [MCP](../integrations/mcp.md)).

## Learning loop

| Method | Path | Scope | Description | Body | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/recall` | `learn` | Retrieve learned skills, memories and the user's profile for a task, as ready-to-inject instructions. | `RecallRequest` | `RecallResponse` |
| `POST` | `/v1/episodes` | `learn` | Record a finished run (messages, tool calls, outcome, verification) so the agent can learn from it. | `EpisodeIn` | `EpisodeOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/episodes:batch` | `learn` | Bulk import of historical runs (offline warm-up: ACE showed warm-starting lifts online learning). | `list[EpisodeIn]` | `dict` |
| `GET` | `/v1/episodes/latest` | `learn` | Most recent episode of a session, so stateless clients can attach feedback to 'the last turn'. |  | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/feedback` | `learn` | Rate a recorded episode (0-1), optionally with a comment or the correct answer. | `FeedbackIn` |  |
| `POST` | `/v1/traces` | `learn` | Zero-code ingestion of OpenTelemetry GenAI / OpenInference traces. |  | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/ask` | `learn` | Answer a question from learned evidence only (skills, memories, profile), with cited evidence ids. | `AskIn` | `AskOut` |

## Skills

| Method | Path | Scope | Description | Body | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/skills` | `learn` | List an agent's skills (plus tenant-shared ones) with their rules and success rates. |  | `list[Skill]` |
| `GET` | `/v1/skills/{ref}` | `learn` | Get one skill by id or name. |  | `Skill` |
| `GET` | `/v1/skills/{ref}/SKILL.md` | `learn` | Export a skill as an agentskills.io-compatible SKILL.md. |  | `str` |
| `GET` | `/v1/skills/{ref}/versions` | `learn` | List a skill's immutable version history. |  | `list[dict]` |
| `POST` | `/v1/skills` | `review` | Create or replace a skill by hand (applied through a governed changeset). | `SkillIn` | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/skills/import` | `review` | Bring existing SKILL.md files (Anthropic / Hermes / agentskills.io) under learning and governance. | `SkillImport` | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/skills/{skill_id}/rollback` | `review` | Restore a skill to an earlier version (recorded as a new version). | `RollbackIn` | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/skills/{skill_id}/pin` | `review` | Pin or unpin a skill. Pinned skills are never archived by the lifecycle. | `PinIn` | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/skills/{skill_id}/evolve` | `review` | Queue an evolution run for a skill. |  | `dict` |

## Memory & profiles

| Method | Path | Scope | Description | Body | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/memories` | `learn` | Add a memory. It is reconciled against existing memories (add, update, supersede or no-op). | `MemoryIn` | `dict` |
| `GET` | `/v1/memories` | `learn` | List memories, optionally for a user, at a point in time (`as_of`) or with superseded history. |  | `list[Memory]` |
| `POST` | `/v1/memories/{memory_id}/approve` | `review` | Approve a memory held for review (e.g. flagged by the safety scan). |  | `dict` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/memories/{memory_id}` | `review` | Hard delete (e.g. data-subject request). Learning itself never hard-deletes; it supersedes. |  |  |
| `GET` | `/v1/profiles/{agent_id}/{user_id}` | `learn` | Get the profile card for a user of an agent. |  | `dict` |

## Governance & insights

| Method | Path | Scope | Description | Body | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/changesets` | `review` | List changesets (proposed skill changes), by default those pending review. |  | `list[Changeset]` |
| `GET` | `/v1/changesets/{cs_id}/proposal` | `review` | A changeset as a reviewable suggestion: current and proposed SKILL.md, a unified diff, and the evidence. |  | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/changesets/{cs_id}/review` | `review` | Approve or reject a pending changeset. Risky changes to proven skills start a canary unless skipped. | `ReviewIn` | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/agents/{agent_id}/reflect` | `review` | Queue reflection over an agent's unreflected episodes now. |  | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/agents/{agent_id}/curate` | `review` | Queue library upkeep for an agent now (dedup, lifecycle, nomination, profiles). |  | `dict` |
| `POST` | `/v1/agents/{agent_id}/replay` | `review` | Re-learn from stored episodes (another epoch), e.g. after importing history or changing the model. | `ReplayIn` | `dict` |
| `GET` | `/v1/agents/{agent_id}/insights` | `learn` | Learning lift vs the holdout group, per-skill success rates, canaries, problem rules and learning cost. |  | `dict` |
| `GET` | `/v1/agents/{agent_id}/export` | `review` | Export episodes with rewards as JSON Lines (for analytics, RL or fine-tuning). |  |  |

## Administration

| Method | Path | Scope | Description | Body | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/admin/api-keys` | `admin` | Create a tenant API key with the given scopes. The key is only shown once. | `KeyIn` | `dict` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/admin/api-keys/{key_id}` | `admin` | Revoke a tenant API key. |  |  |
| `GET` | `/v1/admin/audit` | `admin` | List the tenant's audit log, newest first. |  | `list[dict]` |
| `GET` | `/v1/admin/usage` | `admin` | Learning-side LLM usage per day and purpose (for budgets and chargeback). |  | `list[dict]` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/admin/users/{user_id}` | `admin` | Right to erasure: memories, profile and episodes of a user in this tenant. |  | `dict` |
